scenarios.name: Reopen the dialog after cancelling a folder change

scenario_steps.name: a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/folder-navigation/NativeParent/NativeChild/NavigationDrawing.odd` is staged in a child folder
the user opens and saves that drawing to establish its preview
a drawing was opened from that child folder in the MCAD Software
the Open dialog is showing the same child folder
`NavigationDrawing.odd` was opened from that child folder
the user navigates up to its parent folder
the user cancels the Open dialog
the user reopens the Open dialog in the same session
it displays the original child folder
the file name field identifies the previously opened drawing
